met_analysis:
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level now passes through Sri Ganganagar, Rohtak, Shahjahanpur, Basti, Muzaffarpur and thence east-southeastwards towards Manipur.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over the East Uttar Pradesh persists and now seen at 5.8 km above mean sea level.
The Western Disturbance as cyclonic circulation over Punjab & neighbourhood now lies over Northeast Punjab & neighbourhood at 5.8 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over north Bangladesh & neighbourhood extending upto 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
A trough runs from Northwest Bihar to Manipur across upper air cyclonic circulation over north Bangladesh & neighbourhood at 0.9 km above mean sea level.
An upper air cyclonic circulation lies over Northwest Bihar & neighbourhood between 3.1 & 4.5 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over northeast Assam at 0.9 km above mean sea level has become less marked.
The trough from Telangana to east-central Arabian sea off Karnataka coast between 1.5 & 3.1 km above mean sea level has become less marked.
